pages.text: $(bold)Tobacco Seeds$() drop from $(bold)short grass$() and $(bold)tall grass$(), just like Hemp Seeds. They can also be found in $(bold)Plains Village chests$().$(br)$(br)Plant tobacco seeds on tilled farmland near water. Tobacco grows through several age stages and drops $(bold)Tobacco Leaves$() and more seeds when fully grown.$(br)$(br)Tobacco is needed for crafting $(bold)Joints$() — a smokable item that provides effects from any weed strain mixed with tobacco.
Drops from short and tall grass, and found in Plains Village chests. Plant on farmland to grow Tobacco.
